description: This Perl module defines the TestDB class, which extends a test database class for testing database interactions. It includes methods for creating a test database, executing SQL test data scripts, and verifying database schema upgrades and installations. The file also exports testing functions for database deployment and upgrade operations.

classes.name: TestDB
classes.description: A test database class for setting up and executing test data, extending the base 'DBICx::TestDatabase' class.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes a new test database schema, optionally loading test data from 'share/test_data.sql'.

methods.name: execute_test_data
methods.description: Reads and executes SQL statements from a specified file, typically 'share/test_data.sql', on the provided schema.

methods.name: install_ok
methods.description: Verifies that the database schema can be installed at a specified version, using deployment scripts.

methods.name: upgrade_ok
methods.description: Verifies that the database schema can be upgraded to a specified version, using deployment scripts.
